query: For an 83‑year‑old man: among male ICU patients aged 78–88 with HHS versus age‑matched ICU controls, during the first 48 hours what are the 25th–75th percentiles (and median) of the composite instability score, mean abnormal‑vital burden, mean ICU LOS, and mortality?
final_sql: SELECT male_icu_patients_first_48_hours.hadm_id, male_icu_patients_first_48_hours.stay_id, male_icu_patients_first_48_hours.first_careunit, male_icu_patients_first_48_hours.last_careunit, male_icu_patients_first_48_hours.intime, male_icu_patients_first_48_hours.outtime, male_icu_patients_first_48_hours.los, male_icu_patients_first_48_hours.gender, male_icu_patients_first_48_hours.anchor_age, male_icu_patients_first_48_hours.anchor_year, male_icu_patients_first_48_hours.anchor_year_group, male_icu_patients_first_48_hours.icd_code, male_icu_patients_first_48_hours.icd_version, male_icu_patients_first_48_hours.procedure_code, male_icu_patients_first_48_hours.procedure_version, male_icu_patients_first_48_hours.value, male_icu_patients_first_48_hours.valueuom, male_icu_patients_first_48_hours.test_itemid, male_icu_patients_first_48_hours.test_name, male_icu_patients_first_48_hours.isolate_num, male_icu_patients_first_48_hours.quantity, male_icu_patients_first_48_hours.ab_itemid, male_icu_patients_first_48_hours.ab_name, male_icu_patients_first_48_hours.dilution_text, male_icu_patients_first_48_hours.dilution_comparison, male_icu_patients_first_48_hours.dilution_value, male_icu_patients_first_48_hours.interpretation FROM male_icu_patients_first_48_hours WHERE male_icu_patients_first_48_hours.hadm_id IN (SELECT male_icu_patients_first_48_hours.hadm_id FROM male_icu_patients_first_48_hours JOIN male_icu_controls ON male_icu_patients_first_48_hours.hadm_id = male_icu_controls.hadm_id WHERE male_icu_controls.gender = male_icu_patients_first_48_hours.gender AND male_icu_controls.anchor_age = male_icu_patients_first_48_hours.anchor_age AND male_icu_controls.anchor_year = male_icu_patients_first_48_hours.anchor_year AND male_icu_controls.anchor_year_group = male_icu_patients_first_48_hours.anchor_year_group) ORDER BY male_icu_patients_first_48_hours.hadm_id NULLS LAST;
